out.title: 10 Fairwater Drive, Point Cook, Vic 3030 - House for Sale - realestate.com.au
out.ogDescription:
10 Fairwater Drive, Point Cook

Investate proudly presents this superbly double story home allocated on a large corner block, enjoy all amenities the heart of Point Cook offers. Excellently located five minutes from Point Cook Town Centre, one minutes from Feather brook shopping centre, short walk from parkland and playground, stone thrown away from schools.

This oversized double storeys family home features:
--- DOWNSTAIRS ----
- Large light-filled bedroom with walk-in-closet with easy access to a modern bathroom with shower
- Sitting room with nice street view, good for studio or lounge
- Study/home office room comes with built-in-robe, could turn into the sixth bedroom
- Family room overlooking a court yard
- Additional living space for theatre
- Modern open plan kitchen with upgraded appliances, luxury island bench and walk-in-pantry,
- Spacious open plan living and dining area overlooking nice landscaped back yard
- Oversized laundry room with walk-in linen/storage room and laundry chute

---- UPSTAIRS ----
- Large light-filled master bedroom with his and her walk-in-closet and en-suite bathroom including shower and bathtub
- Another three generous sized bedrooms upstairs with walk-in-closet /large built-in-robe
- large central bathroom with bathtub and shower
- Upstairs family retreat area great for children's playroom , home office or extra living area

---- OUTSIDE---
- Beautifully landscaped front yard, courtyard and good sized back yard.
- Double garage and plenty of street parking space.

This remarkable home truly offers the perfect blend of luxury, space, and lifestyle. Flawless designed layout is perfect for a big family. Don't miss your chance to call it home. Please Contact Novine on 0452 368 806 to make it home!

out.ogDescription:
Positioned in the prestigious Cedar Wood Estate, this superbly designed Carlisle home delivers the ultimate modern lifestyle with multiple light-filled living zones, premium inclusions, and an impressive layout crafted for effortless family living and entertaining. Just moments from Williams Landing Train Station, Town Centre, schools, kindergartens, and major freeway access, this location offers unbeatable convenience for busy families.
Multiple Living Spaces
• Spacious & versatile floorplan featuring Two living zones: formal lounge/theatre room, open-plan family/meals area, and a dedicated cinema room

• Large island bench with ample preparation space
• Quality stainless-steel appliances including 900mm cooktop & oven, dishwasher.

Additional Features : Ducted heating & cooling, security alarm system, High ceilings, downlights & quality light fittings, Solar hot water system, Quality blinds, curtains, plantation shutters & sheer/block-out curtains with double driveway

Location Benefits

• Easy and quick access to the freeway

out.title: 2b Murnong Circuit, Torquay, Vic 3228 - Townhouse for Sale - realestate.com.au
out.ogDescription:
180 Degree Ocean Views

A refined collection of architecturally designed Townhomes, positioned within the tightly held Salt precinct - where contemporary design meets effortless coastal living.

Thoughtfully designed across two levels, each residence offers four bedrooms, two bathrooms, and secure double garaging, with spacious open-plan living positioned to maximise light, privacy, and outlook.

Expansive upper-level living zones flow seamlessly onto a private balcony capturing sweeping 180-degree views and creating the perfect setting for entertaining or unwinding by the coast.

Interiors showcase a clean, modern palette - featuring light timber tones, stone finishes, and full-height glazing - delivering a sense of space, warmth, and understated luxury throughout.

Key features include:

Architecturally designed coastal residences
Open-plan living with seamless indoor–outdoor connection
Four bedrooms, two bathrooms, double garage layouts
Private balconies designed to capture natural light and views
Premium finishes with a timeless, neutral aesthetic
7-star energy rating for long-term comfort and efficiency

This is a rare opportunity to secure a premium position within one of Torquay's most sought-after communities.

Stamp duty savings - Construction commencing soon

Enquire today for more information.
